edistribuzione_modalita.title: Distributor found: E-Distribuzione
edistribuzione_modalita.description:
Choose how to import the consumption of your POD.

**Automatic download, sign-in from the browser**: sign in once on the official E-Distribuzione website from the browser of a computer, open an authorization link and paste here the address it returns. From then on the integration renews the access and downloads the data by itself every day. Your password never goes through Home Assistant. This is an unofficial access: E-Distribuzione may block it at any time.

**Manual load of load curves**: you download the load curve from the E-Distribuzione website (CSV file) and upload it to Home Assistant from the integration options, whenever you want to update the data. Only the POD code is needed, no credentials.

**Automatic download with password and OTP**: the integration signs in by itself with email, password and OTP code. Since October 2026 E-Distribuzione blocks this access, so it is not available for now.

edistribuzione_manuale_pod.title: E-Distribuzione - Manual load
edistribuzione_manuale_pod.description: Enter the POD code (it starts with IT and you can find it on your bill). After creating the setup, open **Configure** to upload the load curve file downloaded from the E-Distribuzione website.

edistribuzione_browser.title: E-Distribuzione - Sign-in from the browser
edistribuzione_browser.description:
1. From a **computer**, open [the E-Distribuzione website]({login_url}) and sign in with the account of your PODs, OTP code included, until you reach the customer area. If the browser is already signed in with a different account, sign out first; if you are already signed in with the right one, go to step 2. Do not use a phone with the E-Distribuzione app installed: the app would open the final address in your place.

2. In the **same window**, **before** opening the authorization link, open the developer tools (**F12**, or **⌥⌘I** on Mac), go to the **Network** tab and tick **Preserve log**. Then open [the authorization link]({url}). If a page with **Consenti** (Allow) appears, press it. The page stays blank or shows an error, and the address bar does not change: this is normal, the final address is meant for the app. The authorization link is valid only for this setup.

3. What you need now is the **final address**, which only appears in the developer tools. It is **not** the authorization link you just opened and **not** the address in the browser bar: it is a very long text starting with `eneldist://redirect`. In the **Network** tab look for the row with status **302**, click it and, under **Headers** → **Response Headers**, copy the value of **Location**. Alternatively, in the **Console** tab a red line `Failed to launch 'eneldist://redirect…'` may appear: copy the whole line. If the copied text does not contain `eneldist://redirect`, it is not the right one. If the browser asks to open an app, cancel: the address has to be copied, not opened.

Your password never goes through Home Assistant: it only receives the access tokens, which it renews by itself.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid Client ID or Secret ID
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the distributor's API
error.pod_duplicato: This POD is already configured in: {pod_conflitto}
error.pod_non_valido: POD or tax code not recognized by the distributor. Check the POD code (it starts with IT and you can find it on your bill) and the tax code or VAT number of the account holder of the supply.
error.areti_pod_non_valido: POD not recognized on this Areti account. Check the code (it starts with IT and you can find it on your bill) and that it is associated with the account you signed in with.
error.invalid_otp: Wrong or expired OTP code. It must be the code sent by this setup: one generated on the website or in the app belongs to a different login session and is always rejected.
error.otp_mancante: Enter the OTP code, or tick "Request a new code" to have a new one sent
error.bloccato_antibot: E-Distribuzione blocked the request with its anti-bot protection before even showing the login, both on the main website and on the alternative address. It does not depend on your credentials: go back and choose the sign-in from the browser.
error.errore_tecnico_portale: E-Distribuzione replied with a generic "Errore Tecnico" (technical error): it does not accept the automatic login on the alternative address the integration uses when the main website blocks it. It does not depend on your credentials: go back and choose the sign-in from the browser.
error.troppe_sessioni: E-Distribuzione refused the sign-in because the account has too many sessions open at the same time. Sign out of the official app and website, wait a few minutes and try again: in this state no OTP code is sent.
error.automatico_non_disponibile: The automatic login with password and OTP has been blocked by E-Distribuzione since October 2026. Choose the sign-in from the browser or the manual load.
error.pod_formato_non_valido: Invalid POD code: it must have the form IT001E12345678 (IT, 3 digits, E, 8 characters).
error.redirect_mancante: The pasted text does not contain any address starting with eneldist://redirect. Neither the address in the browser bar (for example …/AuthorizationPage) nor the authorization link is the right one: open the developer tools (F12) with the Network tab and "Preserve log" enabled **before** opening the authorization link or pressing Consenti (Allow), then copy the Location value of the row with status 302. If after signing in you ended up in the customer area, this is normal: open the authorization link now in the same window.
error.redirect_negato: E-Distribuzione refused the authorization: {dettaglio}. Reopen the authorization link; if it happens again, try later.
error.redirect_altro_tentativo: The address belongs to a different authorization link, for example from a previous attempt. Open the authorization link on this page and paste the new address.
error.redirect_token_mancanti: The address is missing some data ({dettaglio}): it was probably copied only in part. Copy all of it, up to the end of the line.
error.app_bloccata: E-Distribuzione refuses the official app client the integration signs in with (app_blocked). It does not depend on your credentials: try again later.
error.altro_account: The account you signed in with does not see any of the PODs of this setup. Sign out of the portal in the browser, sign in with the right account and reopen the authorization link.
error.areti_password_da_cambiare: Areti requires you to change your password before giving access to the data. Sign in to areariservataclienti.areti.it, set a new password and enter it here.

orario.title: Time of the daily request
orario.description:
From what time to ask the distributor for the previous day's data. Currently: {orario_attuale}.

The initial time was chosen at random between 16:00 and 20:00, so that installations do not all query the distributor at the same moment; the one set here replaces it. The request is made at the first update (one per hour) after this time.

The time at which the data is published is not documented and may vary: if you notice that data is often not returned, try moving it later. A day that was not obtained is not lost anyway: it goes into the queue of days to retry.

edistribuzione_importa_file.title: Upload the load curve
edistribuzione_importa_file.description:
Upload the CSV file of the load curve of POD {pod}, downloaded from the E-Distribuzione website: sign in and open the [Curve di carico]({url_curve}) (load curves) page, choose the period and export the file. The portal exports one month per file, for the last 18 months and up to yesterday: for several months, upload one file at a time.

Days already imported are overwritten: you can upload the same period again without creating duplicates.
